# `aitbc bond lock`

Lock a provider's bond while a high-value job is in flight.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc bond lock [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--provider-id` | text | — | yes | Provider ID. |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc bond lock --provider-id <provider_id>
```

- On-chain record types: `BOND_LOCK`, `BOND_RELEASE`, `BOND_SLASH`
